Tight over-the-shoulder close-up, modern social-first beauty campaign photography, SCARLETT wearing her pale kiosk uniform polo with the collar loose and the hem half-tucked into denim cutoff shorts, an elastic hair tie around her wrist, caught mid-gesture leaning in toward a small mirror as she draws the lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK (Image 3)) across her lower lip, wrist raised and elbow lifted, shoulder blades tensed, the tube angled toward camera with a bright specular flare skating along its metal band, her reflection just entering the edge of frame in soft focus, mouth parted a beat before pressing together, the whole pose loaded with quick unceremonious energy; behind her the cramped Bondi share-house laundry glows almost pure white — square ceramic wall tiles catching hard clean stripes of morning sun thrown by an aluminium louvre window, a folding table jammed against the wall littered with a torn cardboard mailer and crumpled cream tissue paper, a front-load dryer with a ring light clipped to its top edge pushing a soft circular fill into her cheek, a phone perched on a small tripod out of focus in the background, exposed plumbing and laminate benching, dust motes drifting through the sun slats; high-key bright airy exposure with lifted shadows, crisp whites, warm natural skin tones, one coral accent popping against the neutral base; handheld drifting-in framing with slight micro-shake, eye-level and slightly above, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with creamy background bokeh, clean true-to-life digital color, tactile editorial finish, 16:9.
